working_definition: Author cell type 'antennal trichoid sensillum at4' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 7 sensory neuron nuclei): cells of the at4 trichoid sensillum, i.e. its olfactory receptor neurons (Or47b, Or88a, Or65a/b/c). Authors' term FBbt:00067010 is a sensillum (structure).

best_match.fbbt_term: antennal olfactory receptor neuron of trichoid sensillum
best_match.fbbt_definition: Odorant receptor neuron (ORN) whose dendrite transduces signals from a trichoid antennal sensillum.

justification: The authors' term is a sensillum structure, so a cell-level term is needed; the authors' broad class for these cells is sensory neuron. The at4 ORNs (Or47b, Or88a, Or65) are all children of antennal olfactory receptor neuron of trichoid sensillum (verified); FBbt has no single 'at4 ORN' class, so this is the most specific common parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Olfactory trichoid sensillum of antennal segment 3 that houses the dendrites of ORNs Or47b and Or88a, with a subset additionally housing an ORN Or65a dendrite.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Structure, not a cell; cluster relation requires a cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult ORN that expresses Or47b; dendrite in at4.
Adult ORN that expresses Or88a; dendrite in at4.
Adult ORN that expresses Or65a, Or65b and Or65c; dendrite in at4.

recommendation: Broad match to the trichoid ORN class; authors' sensillum term kept in other_candidates.
